# Story 23.1: Red-phase unit tests for the shared input sanitizer and takeUntilDestroyed subscription

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting quantity and price inputs share one sanitizer and that the `valueChanges` subscription is torn down via `takeUntilDestroyed`,
So that Story 23.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it deduplicates sanitization and closes the leak (P2 item #2 from Aspect 2 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that `onQuantityInput` (line ~191) and `onPriceInput` (line ~205) in `add-position-dialog.component.ts` route through one shared sanitizer — both inputs exhibit identical accept/reject behavior for the same input strings (e.g., non-numeric, negative, empty).
2. A spec asserts that the `valueChanges` subscription (line ~120) is torn down when the component is destroyed — no lingering subscription survives after `destroy()` / `takeUntilDestroyed`.
3. All assertions in AC #1–#2 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the dms-material Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 23.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing tests remain unskipped and green.
4. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test dms-material` immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 23.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a shared-sanitizer assertion for quantity + price inputs.
  - [ ] 1.1 In `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/add-position-dialog/add-position-dialog.component.spec.ts`, assert that `onQuantityInput` and `onPriceInput` produce identical accept/reject results for the same input strings (e.g., `"abc"`, `"-5"`, `""`, `"3.14"`).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a takeUntilDestroyed teardown assertion.
  - [ ] 2.1 Assert that after the component is destroyed, the `valueChanges` subscription (line ~120) no longer emits — i.e., it was piped through `takeUntilDestroyed` and completes on destroy.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3, #4): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [ ] 3.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–2 — they are red until Story 23.2 extracts the sanitizer + fixes the leak. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [ ] 3.2 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `add-position-dialog.component.ts` currently sanitizes `onQuantityInput` (line ~191) and `onPriceInput` (line ~205) separately, duplicating logic. Separately, the `valueChanges` subscription at line ~120 is not torn down on destroy — a real memory leak. Extracting one shared sanitizer + fixing with `takeUntilDestroyed` removes duplication and closes the leak (P2 item #2 from Aspect 2).
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 23.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the duplication + leak still exist; Story 23.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then fixes until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code in this story** — unit-test scaffold only. The extraction + fix belongs to Story 23.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; dms-material tests run via `nx test dms-material`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/add-position-dialog/add-position-dialog.component.spec.ts` (add skipped shared-sanitizer + takeUntilDestroyed assertions).
- No changes to production `.ts` in this story.
